correctness.rationale: Geometric lower bound: if L<min(a+2,5), total horizontal and vertical gaps beside the a-square are each <2; reflections ensure left and bottom gaps <1. Every unit square must be wholly right or wholly above the large square. Each strip has width<2, so two unit projections across short direction overlap and projections along length must be disjoint; each strip holds <=4 units because L<5. With eight units, both assigned strips contain four; the rightmost top-assigned square has left coordinate >=3 and the uppermost right-assigned square has bottom >=3, while both lie in [a,L-1] along constrained axes. Since L<5, their horizontal and vertical unit projections overlap strictly, impossible. Separate L>=a+1 follows because otherwise both total coordinate gaps <1 and no unit square can be disjoint. Explicit three coordinate layouts attain the max/min formula including a=1,3,4. Independently checked 10 rational samples and all 360 pairwise closed-square nonoverlap relations; universal result rests on continuous geometric argument.
